hab: Anywhere a screen is left on
The corner office of a city
bio: A flower bud with a pale stripe down its face. One leaf flutters like ticker tape; it knows the price of everything.
When it bloomed, its petals came out orange on black and full of numbers. People pay to look at it.
A flower of glowing panels that ran a city once and would like to again. It reads minds the way it reads markets, and charges for both.
note: Nobody has ever seen it switched off.
